description: This file is a SvelteKit server load and action handlers for a public estimate portal page, enabling clients to view, accept, or decline estimates via a token, without authentication.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches estimate data based on token and prepares data for the page rendering.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Handles user action to accept the estimate via a POST request.

methods.name: decline
methods.description: Handles user action to decline the estimate via a POST request.
